forum.title: Identification of compatible product
forum.category: STM32 MCUs Boards and hardware tools
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@KMarshall and welcome to the ST community,

The device you are showing in the picture is the [STLINK-V2](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/st-link-v2.html).

If you need an update you can migrate to [STLINK-V3](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stlink-v3set.html)

Hope that helps.
forum.content_text:
Hi, Please forgive my ignorance in advance.

I have been asked to acquire the equivalent of the hardware show in the attached photographs (both items).

I am hoping that someone in the community can point me at the relevant product in on this website. I don’t have experience of what the product is used for to be able to make a proper judgement myself.

I suspect the one that I have is old and has been replaced with a newer model, hence my inability to find a direct match in the product pages.

Any assistance would be much appreciated.

Thank you for your time.
